notes:
- Clips play at the same loudness as the rest of the feed (-14 LUFS), and the music sits closer under the voice so you can hear it.
- The on-screen hook is written to the OST rules: 6 to 8 words, a second line in brackets, something the speaker doesn't already say, and checked a second time before the clip is made. Titles are never cut off.
- The Hook Box title is bold.
- Wide shots fill the frame, centred on the people, with no stretched edges or black band.
- Captions beside the speaker move to the other side when the shot cuts to the person across from them; they never join two people's words.
- Clips start and end on whole sentences, never on a reply like \"Gotcha\" or a line like \"the second reason\". Recordings whose transcript lost its punctuation are fixed when opened.
- No more stray capitals (\"The\", \"A\") in captions; brands keep their spelling (YouTube); captions never show words nobody said.
- No flash of another shot at a clip's start or end; titles leave on the next shot change; captions, punch-ins and the framing all switch on the exact frame of a cut.
- B-roll never shows someone other than the speaker; Type Stack finds B-roll in subfolders.
- A clip whose cuts couldn't be made perfectly clean says \"Check the cuts\".
